name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
famous_for: Stari Most (Old Bridge) in Mostar, historic Ottoman Baščaršija bazaar, and Balkan coffee tradition.
tourists: Over 1.7M visitors; highlights include Kravica Waterfalls, Sarajevo Old Town, and Blagaj Tekke monastery.
must_know: Drinking traditional Bosnian coffee (bosanska kafa) from a copper dzezva with rahat lokum is an unhurried ritual.
fun_fact: Sarajevo was the first city in Europe to have a full-time operational electric tram network in 1885.
